notes.title: Ribbet Release
notes.notes:
🎉 Ribbet is OFFICIALLY OUT NOW! 🐸🎮

The moment we’ve all been waiting for is here — Ribbet is finally LIVE! 🙌 After lots of hard work, dedication, and support, we are beyond excited to share this game with you.

A huge THANK YOU to everyone who made this possible:
    •    To our incredible team for pouring their hearts into every detail.
    •    To the amazing folks over at Screen Queensland for their unwavering support and collaboration.
    •    And to everyone — players, fans, and the community — for your feedback, love, and belief in Ribbet from day one.

We couldn’t have done this without you, and we are so grateful to have you along for this journey. 🧡

Now, hop into Ribbet and start your adventure! We can’t wait to hear what you think.

Download now!  and join us in celebrating the launch of Ribbet!

Be sure to join our discord to stay upto date with future announcements and share your experiences with Ribbet!  [b][url=https://discord.gg/3hfqBtze5g]Ribbet Discord[/url][/b]

Thank you again to everyone who’s been part of this adventure. Let’s make some unforgettable memories together! 💚🐸
